# Neha Couture

> Premium South Asian and Indian bridal, festive, and ethnic wear boutique based in Berlin, Germany, serving Germany and Europe with 1–3 day express dispatch.

## Brand Identity & Entity Information
- **Brand Name:** Neha Couture
- **Founder & Creative Director:** Neha Aggarwal
- **Primary Website:** https://nehacouture.de
- **Industry & Type:** South Asian Fashion, Indian Bridal Boutique, Online Business
- **Customer Ratings:** 4.9 / 5.0 (133+ Google Verified Reviews)

## Locations & Physical Presence
- **Retail Showroom Boutique (Shopping, Try-ons & In-Person Returns):**
  The Playce (Potsdamer Platz), Shop No. 55, Level -1, Alte Potsdamer Str. 7, 10785 Berlin, Germany
  *Hours:* Monday – Saturday 10:00 – 20:00
  *Note:* In-person styling, walk-in shopping, and hand returns/exchanges accepted here.
- **Logistics Center & Postal Returns Office (Mailed Returns Only):**
  Neha Aggarwal
  Dolgenseestr. 9A, 10319 Berlin, Germany
  *Note:* All postal/carrier return parcels must be shipped exclusively to this Dolgenseestr address. Parcels cannot be delivered by mail carriers to the Potsdamer Platz mall store.

## Delivery & Policies
- **Germany Delivery:** 1–3 business days via DHL tracked shipping. Express dispatch from Berlin hub.
- **European Union & Switzerland:** 3–5 business days tracked shipping with zero customs duties for EU destinations.
- **Accepted Payment Methods:** Credit Card, Debit Card (Visa, Mastercard, Maestro), and Bank Deposit / Bank Transfer. (PayPal and Klarna are not accepted).
- **Return Policy:** 14-day return window for unworn items with original tags.
- **Virtual Video Styling:** Free 1-on-1 live video consultation via WhatsApp (+49 1517 5316266) to inspect embroidery, fabrics, and verify sizing before ordering.
